description: This file declares functions related to device number allocation and management for Zigbee legacy security devices, including retrieving, setting, and clearing device numbers, as well as obtaining EUI64 identifiers.

methods.name: allocateDeviceNumber
methods.description: Gets the next available legacy security device number and persists it on the device.

methods.name: getDeviceNumberForDevice
methods.description: Gets the device number used by the specified device from persistent storage.

methods.name: getEui64ForDeviceNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the EUI64 identifier of the device corresponding to the given device number.

methods.name: clearTemporaryDeviceNumbers
methods.description: Clears any temporary device numbers used during pairing.

methods.name: setDeviceNumberForDevice
methods.description: Sets the device number for a device, primarily used during migration.
